explanation: OEIS A113250 (g.f. −(1 − 48x² − 256x³)/((1 − 4x)(1 + 4x)(1 + 4x + 16x²)), the m = 4 member of a family): 'Conjecture: a(m, 2n+1) is a perfect square for all m'. The denominator expands to 1 + 4x − 64x³ − 256x⁴, so the formal recurrence a(n) = −4a(n−1) + 64a(n−3) + 256a(n−4) with initial terms −1, 4, 32, 64 matches the DATA. The statement asserts a(2n+1) is a square for all n, i.e. the conjecture specialised to m = 4, which is this sequence (as the docstring says). Faithful.
